english.title: Fail to carry technical log / approved record in a non-Part-21 aircraft and keep copy of entries required on the ground
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[pilot in command]_
(B)_[operator]_of a non-Part-21 aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), to which article 227(1) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 applied

(C)_[and in which the technical log or approved record was not carried when article 229 of the Order so required]_
(D)_[when a copy of the entries required by article 227 was not kept on the ground]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 227(8) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the pilot in command / operator of a non-Part-21 aircraft to which article 227(1) of the Order 2016 applied
and in which the technical log or approved record was not carried when article 229 of the Order so required OR
a copy of the entries required by article 227 was not kept on the ground
